content: yabai (source): single serial event_loop thread with queued typed events (APPLICATION_*, WINDOW_*, SLS_*, SPACE_CHANGED, DISPLAY_*, MOUSE_*, MISSION_CONTROL_*, SYSTEM_WOKE); one view (BSP window_node tree with float ratio) per Space id, view->uuid via SLSSpaceCopyName; invisible spaces marked dirty and relaid on show; WINDOW_RESIZED debounced by comparing to cached frame and AX_DIFF tolerance 1.5pt vs node area; animation uses SLSHWCaptureWindowList proxy windows + transforms, swap requires scripting addition (SIP).
